districts.name: Latin pop and football
districts.blurb: Leans toward Karol G, Bad Bunny, Shakira, Messi, LeBron James and Coldplay, and away from Fortnite and Call of Duty.

districts.name: Podcasts, sitcoms and gaming
districts.blurb: Over-indexes on Call Her Daddy, Joe Rogan, Fortnite, Call of Duty, Minecraft and Friends; light on Burna Boy and Supreme.

districts.name: Afrobeats, sneakers and shooters
districts.blurb: Strong on Call of Duty, Burna Boy, Supreme, Nike, Fortnite and Travis Scott; low on Taylor Swift and The Office.

districts.name: K-pop, country and Uniqlo
districts.blurb: Big over-indexes on Uniqlo, Luke Combs, Morgan Wallen, BTS, Radiohead and Phoebe Bridgers; less Minecraft and Call of Duty.

districts.name: Indie rock and Drag Race
districts.blurb: Leans toward Phoebe Bridgers, Radiohead, Drag Race, SZA, Tyler, the Creator and Kendrick Lamar; away from Joe Rogan and gaming.
